gestures.notes: Prototype redrawn pose assets; neutral uses parent path unchanged; discrete pose switching, small hand oscillation only; R arm only. 07c uses source-texture remapping and hand shading; no new anatomy/transition.

gestureTransition.notes: Offline forward skeletal warp, single dominant silhouette and color blend only within overlapping opaque regions; discrete hand contour switch near 65%; 19 intermediate frames per route. Only hoodie/cardigan. Exact existing endpoints.

qualityRevision.method: Single source contour/line art, bounded low-frequency tone correction, distal wrist protection

gesturePerformance.notes: Optional timing and additive head/gaze cue, no extra images; continuous monotone Hermite timing; one-shot auto-return; legacy immediate API preserved.

secondaryMotion.notes: Angles in degrees except hair normalized additive. Shared upper root at waist, right arm group at existing shoulder. Bounded velocity-driven secondary animation; no extra images; independent cloth mesh not implemented.

accessoryMotion.note: Original art retained; bounded localized warp variants, not independently extracted cord/ribbon. 17 discrete levels including zero. Two pendant anchors fixed.

deployment.encoding: original PNG bytes; WebP trial rejected after browser pixel comparison
